meta.note: Exercise -> muscles for anatomy.html. primary counts 1 set, secondary 0.5 set in the volume heatmap. Exercises not listed fall back to group_fallback by their Hevy group.

Bench Press (Barbell).cue: Shoulder blades pinned, touch low chest, drive feet into the floor.

Bench Press - Close Grip (Barbell).cue: Hands just inside shoulder width, elbows tucked about 30°.

Feet Up Bench Press (Barbell).cue: No leg drive, so the chest and triceps do all the work. Stay tight through the torso.

Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell).cue: Bench at 30°. Lower to the upper chest with a deep stretch.

Incline Chest Press (Machine).cue: Set the seat so the handles start level with the upper chest.

Chest Press (Machine).cue: Keep the shoulders back on the pad. Don't let them roll forward at lockout.

Butterfly (Pec Deck).cue: Soft elbows, hug a barrel, pause at the squeeze.

Chest Fly (Dumbbell).cue: Open wide to a stretch and keep the elbow angle fixed.

Seated Chest Flys (Cable).cue: Constant tension. Bring the hands together in front of the sternum.

Chest Dip.cue: Lean forward and lower until the shoulders are just below the elbows.

Plyometric Push Ups.cue: Explode off the floor, land soft, reset each rep.

Plyometric Push-Ups.cue: Explode off the floor, land soft, reset each rep.

Push Up (Weighted).cue: Plank body. Push the floor away at the top to work the serratus.

Pull Up.cue: Start from a dead hang, pull the chest to the bar, elbows to the back pockets.

Pull Up (Weighted).cue: Full hang every rep. Stop the set when the chin no longer clears.

Lat Pulldown (Cable).cue: Lean back slightly and pull to the upper chest, not behind the neck.

Lat Pulldown (Machine).cue: Drive the elbows down and in. Control the return up.

Lat Pulldown - Close Grip (Cable).cue: Neutral grip and a long stretch at the top.

Reverse Grip Lat Pulldown (Cable).cue: Palms toward you and elbows tight. Pull to the sternum.

Single Arm Lat Pulldown.cue: Let the shoulder rise at the top, then pull the elbow to the hip.

Iso-Lateral Row (Machine).cue: Chest on the pad. Lead with the elbow and squeeze the shoulder blades.

Bent Over Row (Barbell).cue: Hinge to about 45° and pull the bar to the belly button.

Bent Over Row (Smith Machine).cue: Fixed bar path, so keep the hinge angle locked.

Seated Row (Machine).cue: Tall chest. Squeeze for a second at the back.

Seated Cable Row - V Grip (Cable).cue: Pull to the lower ribs and don't rock the torso.

Seated Cable Row - Bar Wide Grip.cue: Wide grip, elbows flared. Pull to the upper belly.

Single Arm Cable Row.cue: Let the shoulder reach forward, then row and rotate slightly.

Dumbbell Row.cue: Flat back. Row the dumbbell to the hip.

T Bar Row.cue: Chest up. Pull the handle to the sternum.

Shoulder Press (Dumbbell).cue: Ribs down. Press up and slightly in, with no lower-back arch.

Seated Shoulder Press (Machine).cue: Back flat on the pad. Lower to ear height.

Overhead Press (Barbell).cue: Glutes tight. Bring the head through once the bar passes the forehead.

Push Press.cue: Short dip, explosive drive, lock out overhead.

Arnold Press (Dumbbell).cue: Rotate the palms outward as you press.

Lateral Raise (Dumbbell).cue: Lead with the elbows and stop at shoulder height. Don't shrug.

Seated Lateral Raise (Dumbbell).cue: Seated takes away momentum. Use a slow lowering.

Lateral Raise (Machine).cue: Push the pads out with the elbows. Pause at the top.

Lateral Raise (Cable).cue: Start the cable behind the body for tension at the bottom.

Face Pull.cue: Pull to the eyes, then rotate the hands back past the ears.

Rear Delt Reverse Fly (Dumbbell).cue: Hinge over and sweep wide with soft elbows. Light weight.

Rear Delt Reverse Fly (Machine).cue: Arms wide. Don't let the shoulder blades do the work.

Overhead Triceps Extension (Cable).cue: Elbows by the ears for a deep long-head stretch.

Triceps Pushdown.cue: Pin the elbows to the sides and lock out hard.

Triceps Rope Pushdown.cue: Spread the rope apart at the bottom.

Single Arm Triceps Pushdown (Cable).cue: One arm at a time. Keep the elbow still.

Single Arm Tricep Extension (Dumbbell).cue: Upper arm vertical. Lower behind the head.

Skullcrusher (Dumbbell).cue: Lower toward the forehead and keep the upper arms angled back.

Skullcrusher (Barbell).cue: EZ or straight bar. Lower just behind the head.

Triceps Kickback (Dumbbell).cue: Upper arm parallel to the floor. Squeeze at full extension.

Triceps Dip.cue: Stay upright to keep the load on the triceps.

Cross Body Hammer Curl.cue: Curl across the body toward the opposite chest.

Seated Incline Hammer Curl (Dumbbell).cue: Arms hang behind the body for a long stretch.

Bicep Curl (Dumbbell).cue: Turn the palms up as you curl. Slow lowering.

Seated Incline Curl (Dumbbell).cue: Long-head stretch. Keep the elbows still.

EZ Bar Biceps Curl.cue: Elbows at the sides and a full range of motion.

Preacher Curl (Barbell).cue: Armpits on the pad. Don't bounce at the bottom.

Preacher Curl (Machine).cue: Full stretch, then squeeze at the top.

Squat (Barbell).cue: Brace, then sit between the hips with knees tracking over the toes. Hit depth.

Zercher Squat.cue: Bar in the elbow crease. Stay tall through the upper back.

Goblet Squat.cue: Hold the bell at the chest. Push the knees out with the elbows.

Jump Squat.cue: Quarter dip and jump high. Land quietly.

Sissy Squat (Weighted).cue: Knees forward and hips extended, so the quads take the whole load.

Leg Press (Machine).cue: Low back stays on the pad. Go as deep as you can without the hips tucking.

Leg Extension (Machine).cue: Pause at lockout and lower slowly.

Bulgarian Split Squat.cue: Front shin roughly vertical for glutes, knee forward for quads.

Bulgarian Split Squat (Dumbbell).cue: Drop the back knee straight down and drive through the front foot.

Split Squat (Dumbbell).cue: Long stance and a vertical torso.

Dumbbell Step Up.cue: Drive through the top foot, not the back toe.

Step Up.cue: Drive through the top foot, not the back toe.

Deadlift (Barbell).cue: Bar over mid-foot, take the slack out, push the floor away.

Romanian Deadlift (Barbell).cue: Push the hips back with soft knees. Bar stays on the legs.

Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell).cue: Push the hips back and feel the hamstring stretch.

Straight Leg Deadlift.cue: Near-straight knees. Stop where the back starts to round.

Single Leg Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell).cue: Square the hips and reach the back heel away.

Hip Thrust (Barbell).cue: Chin tucked and ribs down. Lock out with the glutes, not the back.

Back Extension (Weighted Hyperextension).cue: Hinge at the hips and stop at a straight line.

Back Extension (Hyperextension).cue: Hinge at the hips and stop at a straight line.

Seated Leg Curl (Machine).cue: Lean forward for a longer hamstring stretch.

Standing Leg Curls.cue: Keep the hips square and curl slowly.

Hip Adduction (Machine).cue: Control the opening. Squeeze for one second.

Standing Calf Raise.cue: Straight knee works the gastroc. Pause in the full stretch.

Standing Calf Raise (Machine).cue: Straight knee works the gastroc. Pause in the full stretch.

Standing Calf Raise (Smith).cue: Straight knee works the gastroc. Pause in the full stretch.

Single Leg Standing Calf Raise.cue: Full range on one leg. Hold something for balance only.

Single Leg Standing Calf Raise (Dumbbell.cue: Full range on one leg. Hold something for balance only.

Seated Calf Raise.cue: Bent knee takes the gastroc out of it, so the soleus does the work. Key for running.

Calf Press (Machine).cue: Push through the big toe. Slow lowering.

Pogo Hops.cue: Stiff ankles and quick ground contacts.

Tibialis Raise.cue: Heels down, then lift the toes as high as they go.

Hanging Knee Raise.cue: Curl the pelvis up and don't swing.

Hanging Leg Raise.cue: Straight legs, posterior tilt at the top.

Decline Crunch (Weighted).cue: Curl the spine. Don't just hinge at the hips.

Crunch (Machine).cue: Ribs toward the pelvis and exhale hard.

Cable Crunch.cue: Hips fixed, curl the elbows to the knees.

Seated Wrist Extension (Barbell).cue: Forearms on the thighs. Small, slow range.

Wrist Roller.cue: Arms straight. Roll up and lower under control.
